summary: Affected-flow adjudication completed against fix-review-source.json plus the disclosed navigation and test-settle addenda. The three first-pass findings are resolved: same-selection F frames the node, all six tab groups use the shared keyboard/panel contract, and Organization falls back to an available tab. The additional stale singleton/empty framing replay and catalog route-alias focus failures are addressed. No supported findings remain within this affected scope.
coverage: Read keyboard-fix-review-brief.txt, original keyboard-review.json/source validation, applicable invariants and DESIGN.md keyboard requirements; this is inherited-context adjudication, not a fresh independent pass.

Both selectedId changes and explicit one-node focusSeq changes now invoke frameNode. A stale singleton request whose id differs from the current selection is ignored on remount; an empty request returns home only with no newer selected requirement.

Repository-wide role=tab/tablist/tabpanel search now finds those roles only in the shared primitive. Each rendered available tab has a unique group-prefixed id, panel controls/label association, selected-only tab stop, and shared wrapping ArrowLeft/Right plus Home/End handlers.

AgentsPage launcher remains outside active panels; runs/inbox panels retain former conditional-content lifetime and capability-gated callbacks. RMF Lifecycle retains styled step cards, readiness/default-step selection and canonical task destinations inside associated panels. Shared Tabs custom rendering/class options preserve default behavior of the original inspector and Organization consumers.

ThreatsPage catalog tabs/panels, catalog-identity guard on placeholder data, inspector selection removal, and loading behavior inspected. Navigation addendum at ThreatsPage.tsx:300,362 preserves routeWs for catalog-tab changes; canonical ws still owns threat query keys/requests at :308-312. This avoids the Shell bootstrap loading/remount path while retaining the existing alias and tab useId/focus.

e2e/keyboard-outline.spec.ts:238-292 pixel-hash F and remount regressions inspected: manual camera change must alter raster, F must recover the selected pose, and cached B remount must retain B framing after an earlier A request. New dialog/tabs tests inspect all six group associations, wrapping keyboard behavior, launcher draft/no-write behavior, canonical RMF links, and held catalog loading without stale controls. Final catalog test awaits aria-selected route commits before association checks.

Root-owned logs inspected: f-before.log and camera-remount-before.log show original pixel-hash failures; review-fixes-browser-1.log records F and Organization fallback passing; keyboard-browser-final.log records 22 passed and one catalog focus failure, with F/remount passing. catalog-focus-after.log records the subsequent asynchronous association-helper failure; catalog-focus-final.log records the corrected focused catalog test passing. No runtime commands were executed by this reviewer.

Start and end SHA-256 validation performed. Original fix snapshot matched at start. End preserves the declared ThreatsPage and dialog-tabs-test mismatches; the latest fix-review-source-test-settle-addendum.json matches every entry. First-pass artifacts were left unchanged.
